**Current**
- In drafts he often goes in round 12. (fact, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/D4dP5JvX1oo?t=1664))
- LeBron James and Rui Hachimura left the Lakers. That opens usage for the players who remain. (fact, 2026-10-08; [07-01](https://youtu.be/W3THnI7wWdA?t=872), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=1225), [08-04](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=306))
- Experts expect him to start for the Lakers and play about 30 minutes. One expert is fairly confident. (verdict, 2026-10-06; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=294), [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=1441), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=1969), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=2070), [08-04](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=528))
- The starting spot is not settled. LaRavia or Ziaire Williams could start instead. Whoever comes off the bench is still expected to play about 27 minutes. (fact, 2026-10-06; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=1441), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=2070), [08-04](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=669), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=2370))
- He is a high-end late flyer. On his own his best case is about top 110. (verdict, 2026-10-06; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=1050), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=2070))
- He is also a handcuff for Doncic and Reaves. If one of them misses time, he becomes the number two option and could have a top 70 run. Another expert puts that upside at top 80. (verdict, 2026-10-06, until Doncic or Reaves misses time; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=1070), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=1969), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=2070))
- The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league. (fact, 2026-10-06; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=2119))
- The Lakers play 3-4-3 games in our playoff weeks (March 28 end). That is in the bottom half of the league. (fact, 2026-10-06; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=2036))
- Doncic's health is seen as a risk for the Lakers, which adds to his handcuff value. (verdict, 2026-08-05; [08-05](https://youtu.be/CI4k8ofUXXk?t=103))
- Andy expects him to start because he is the team's best point of attack defender who can also score and handle the ball. (verdict, 2026-08-04; [08-04](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=528))

**Durable**
- His category profile is balanced, with no big strength or weakness. Threes are his best category and FG% is his weakest. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- When he had big usage running point guard on a tanking Philadelphia team, he scored big and shot very well. (fact, 2026-10-06; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=1014))

**Tags**
- Current: `flyer` (high-end late flyer, best case top 110 on his own), `handcuff` (top 70 to 80 run if Doncic or Reaves misses time; until Doncic or Reaves misses time), `sleeper` (goes in round 12; expert sees best case top 110), `minutes competition` (LaRavia or Ziaire Williams could start instead), `usage competition` (plays next to Doncic and Reaves), `many back-to-backs` (Lakers have the second most back-to-backs), `bad playoff schedule` (3-4-3 with a March 28 end, bottom half of the league)
- Durable: `fits every build` (no category flagged weak)

**Note.** Grimes is priced as an endgame player: Yahoo values him at 0 USD (average cost 1.0 USD) and ESPN at 2 USD, with ranks of 126 and 119. That puts him near the end of our 144-player draft, so he is a 1 to 2 USD last pick or a waiver target. His appeal is a likely starting role at about 30 minutes, with a top 70 to 80 run if Doncic or Reaves misses time. His balanced line (threes best, FG% weakest) fits any build. Early in the season, check that he starts ahead of LaRavia and Ziaire Williams and plays close to 30 minutes, and watch Doncic's health.
